ns2:course.label: Electromagnetic Fields I
ns2:course.description: Concerns static electric and magnetic fields, their interactions with electric charge and current, and their transformation properties; the effect of special relativity is incorporated. Macroscopic fields in material media are described. Prerequisite: PHYS 325; MATH 385; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 241 (formerly MATH 243) or MATH 380.
